title: Addition–Affine Cipher with Provable Differential and Linear Resistance
summary: LAX proves single-trail differential bounds, but its linear bound fails; constructing a modular-addition and binary-field-affine cipher with provable resistance to both attacks remains open.

formal_statement.body: Construct a cipher using only addition modulo $2^n$ and $\mathrm{GF}(2)$-affine functions, with provable differential and linear resistance.

scope.domain: Block-cipher design restricted to addition modulo $2^n$ and $\mathrm{GF}(2)$-affine functions, targeting resistance to differential and linear cryptanalysis.
parameters: $n$: exponent defining the modulus $2^n$ for addition
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a cipher under this operation restriction with provable differential and linear resistance.

citations.label: Design Strategies for ARX with Provable Bounds: Sparx and LAX

progress.summary: The source presents LAX as satisfying only the differential side of the challenge through provable single-trail bounds, while its corresponding linear bound fails. It explicitly states that the full Wallén challenge remains open.
citation_labels: Daniel Dinu et al., Design Strategies for ARX with Provable Bounds: Sparx and LAX
